title: Add ensemble profile serializer and compact release snippet generation
author: Priya Desai
description: Context: As we onboard more model variants and quantized builds, customers need a concise way to publish a single canonical performance summary for a model family (latency/cost/quality across representative variants) and an easy changelog snippet that product teams can paste into release notes. This PR introduces an 'ensemble profile' serializer that coalesces multiple per-variant profiles into a compact binary+JSON artifact and a CLI hook that emits a human-readable release teaser (one-paragraph blurb + top-3 metrics + example inference trace) suitable for automated changelogs. Motivation: reduce noise from large multi-variant changelogs, speed up release note drafting, and provide a stable artifact we can reference in CI and the private installer. What this PR does: - Adds an ensemble serializer that merges profiles and keeps provenance (hash of contributing profiles, timestamp, sample counts). The serializer supports two output modes: compact-binary (for runtime distribution) and annotated-json (for changelog generation). - Adds a release-teaser generator CLI that reads annotated-json artifacts and produces a 2-3 sentence blurb with top metrics and a redacted inference example. The CLI can be run as a Linear post-merge hook or manually during onboarding. - Integrates the serializer into the onboarding pipeline: a new step in onboarder will auto-generate an ensemble when more than one variant is present and persist the artifact to model-storage. - Adds basic property-based tests and end-to-end smoke tests that run in the model-registry pipeline. Design notes: - Ensemble merging rules: weighted average for latency/cost (weights = sample_count), conservative min/median/90p reporting for quality metrics (so we avoid optimistic summaries). - Provenance: each ensemble contains a contributors list (model id + profile hash) and a digest so it can be validated later. - Backwards compatible: nothing overwrites existing profile artifacts; this is an additive artifact type (artifact_type = "ensemble:v1"). How to use: - CLI: tools/teasergen/bin/teasergen --input artifacts/ensemble-<model>-<date>.json --format markdown - Onboarding: set onboard_config.generate_ensemble = true in the onboarding manifest. Testing and rollout: feature gated behind a runtime flag (model-registry.feature.ensemble_profiles). We'll enable for internal staging for one week, collect feedback, then flip for public on the next release. Related: referenced ENG-4129 for changelog automation effort and ENG-4288 for onboarding pipeline stabilization.
